bananaman_43046: In Old Harrow, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman was a fisherman. In S-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a fisherman again.
spring_7398: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Spring arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Yann Spring helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
